lyrics.translation: Hey, what is your dream?
(What is it?)
Hey, what is your dream?
(What is it?)
Hey, what is your dream?
(What is it?)
Is that really all you dream of?

lyrics.line: I wanna big house, big cars, and big rings
lyrics.translation: I wanna big house, big cars, and big rings

lyrics.line: But 사실은, I don't have any big dreams
lyrics.translation: But 사실은, I don't have any big dreams
Haha, I live so comfortably

lyrics.line: 꿈 따위 안 꿔도 아무도 뭐라 안 하잖어
lyrics.romanized: kkum tta-wi an kkwodo amudo mwola an hajanh-eo
lyrics.translation: No one says anything if I don’t dream at all

lyrics.line: 전부 다, 다, 다 똑가-같이 나처럼 생각하고 있어
lyrics.romanized: jeonbu da, da, da ttogga-gat-i nacheoleom saenggaghago iss-eo
lyrics.translation: Everyone, everyone, everyone thinks just like me

lyrics.line: 새까-까-까맣게 까먹은 꿈 많던 어린 시절
lyrics.romanized: sae-kka-kka-kkamahge kkameog-eun kkum manhdeon eolin sijeol
lyrics.translation: The dreams I forgot in my childhood, all blacked out

lyrics.line: 대학은 걱정 마 멀리라도 갈 거니까
lyrics.romanized: daehag-eun geogjeong ma meollilado gal geoni-kka
lyrics.translation: Don’t worry about college, I’ll go far away
I got it, Mom, I’m in the study room now
I’m going, you know
What is the image you’ve been dreaming of?

lyrics.line: 지금 네 거울 속엔 누가 보여? I gotta say
lyrics.romanized: jigeum ne geo-ul sog-en nuga bo-yeo? I gotta say
lyrics.translation: Who do you see in your mirror now? I gotta say

lyrics.line: 너의 길을 가라고, 단 하루를 살아도
lyrics.romanized: neo-ui gil-eul galago, dan haluleul sal-ado
lyrics.translation: Walk your own path, even if it’s just for one day
Do something, keep your weakness inside

lyrics.line: 왜 말 못하고 있어? 공부는 하기 싫다면서
lyrics.romanized: wae mal moshago iss-eo? gongbuneun hagi silhdamyeonseo
lyrics.translation: Why can’t you speak? You say you don’t want to study

lyrics.line: 학교 때려 치기는 겁나지? 이거 봐, 등교할 준비하네 벌써
lyrics.romanized: haggyo ttaelyeo chigineun geobnaji? igeo bwa, deunggyohal junbihane beol-sseo
lyrics.translation: Scared to drop out of school, right? Look, you’re already getting ready for class

lyrics.line: 철 좀 들어 제발 좀, 너 입만 살아가지고, 임마, 유리멘탈, boy
lyrics.romanized: cheol jom deul-eo jebal jom, neo ibman sal-agajigo, imma, yulimental, boy
lyrics.translation: Please grow up a little, you’re just all talk, boy, with a fragile heart

lyrics.line: Stop, 자신에게 물어봐, 언제 네가 열심히 노력했냐고
lyrics.romanized: Stop, jasin-ege mul-eobwa, eonje nega yeolsimhi nolyeoghaessnyago
lyrics.translation: Stop, ask yourself, when did you really put in the effort?
Hey, what is your dream?
(What is it?)
Hey, what is your dream?
(What is it?)
Hey, what is your dream?
(What is it?)
Is that really all you dream of?
That’s a lie, you’re such a liar

lyrics.line: See me, see me, yah, 넌 위선자야
lyrics.romanized: See me, see me, yah, neon wiseonja-ya
lyrics.translation: See me, see me, yah, you’re a hypocrite

lyrics.line: 왜 자꾸 딴 길을 가래? 야, 너나 잘해
lyrics.romanized: wae ja-kku ttan gil-eul galae? ya, neona jalhae
lyrics.translation: Why do you keep going down a different path? Hey, mind your own business
Please don’t force me
(Say) La, la, la, la, la

lyrics.line: 네 꿈이 뭐니? 네 꿈이 뭐니, 뭐니?
lyrics.romanized: ne kkum-i mwoni? ne kkum-i mwoni, mwoni?
lyrics.translation: What is your dream? What is your dream, what is it?
(Say) La, la, la, la, la
Is this all there is? Is this all there is?

lyrics.line: Okay, 지겨운 same day, 반복되는 매일에
lyrics.romanized: Okay, jigyeo-un same day, banbogdoeneun mae-il-e
lyrics.translation: Okay, the same boring day, repeating every day

lyrics.line: 어른들과 부모님은 틀에 박힌 꿈을 주입해
lyrics.romanized: eoleundeulgwa bumonim-eun teul-e baghin kkum-eul ju-ibhae
lyrics.translation: Adults and parents inject their rigid dreams
Future ambition number one: civil servant?
It’s not a forced dream, it’s a relief pitcher

lyrics.line: 시간낭비인 야자에 돌직구를 날려지옥 같은 사회에 반항해 꿈을 특별사면
lyrics.romanized: sigannangbi-in yaja-e doljigguleul nallyeoji-og gat-eun sahoe-e banhanghae kkum-eul teugbyeolsamyeon
lyrics.translation: Throw a fastball at the wasted time of study hall, rebel against this hellish society, dream of a special pardon
Ask yourself about the profile of your dream

lyrics.line: 억압만 받던 인생 네 삶의 주어가 되어봐
lyrics.romanized: eog-abman baddeon insaeng ne salm-ui ju-eoga doe-eobwa
lyrics.translation: Be the subject of your life that was only oppressed
What is the image you’ve been dreaming of?

Is this all there is? Is this all there is?
I don’t know how to live
I don’t know how to fly
I don’t know how to decide
Now I don’t even know how to dream

lyrics.line: 눈을, 눈을, 눈을 떠라 다 이제
lyrics.romanized: nun-eul, nun-eul, nun-eul tteola da ije
lyrics.translation: Open your eyes, open your eyes, open your eyes, everyone now

lyrics.line: 춤을, 춤을, 춤을 춰봐 자 다시
lyrics.romanized: chum-eul, chum-eul, chum-eul chwobwa ja dasi
lyrics.translation: Dance, dance, dance again
Dream, dream, dream, everyone

lyrics.line: 너 꾸물대지 마, 우물쭈물 대지 마, what's up?
lyrics.romanized: neo kkumuldaeji ma, umuljjumul daeji ma, what's up?
lyrics.translation: Don’t dawdle, don’t hesitate, what’s up?
